additional_info.subject: ID0482966-DC/Si-D/DE- [Null] Meter value WH Missing CRM:03288000463
additional_info.body:
Dear Abhishek,
thank you for your mail and your investigation.
I’m adding some more details in the mail to specify our request more precisely.
During a charging process, we receive the following data from the charger:
{
"connectorId": 1,
"transactionId": 808531760,
"meterValue": [
{
"timestamp": "2026-02-21T09:33:21.762Z",
"sampledValue": [
{
"value": "82",
"location": "EV",
"unit": "Percent",
"measurand": "SoC",
"context": "Sample.Periodic"
},
{
"value": "120000",
"location": "Outlet",
"unit": "W",
"measurand": "Power.Offered",
"context": "Sample.Periodic"
},
{
"value": "153",
"location": "Outlet",
"unit": "A",
"measurand": "Current.Offered",
"context": "Sample.Periodic"
}
]
Form other chargers, we additionally receive the information about the consumed power like in the example below:
"timestamp": "2026-03-12T07:38:06.491Z",
"sampledValue": [
{
"value": "91038598",
"context": "Sample.Periodic",
"measurand": "Energy.Active.Import.Register",
"location": "Outlet",
"unit": "Wh"
For your charger model we don’t receive this information during the charging process but only at the end of the charging process. Since we would like to provide this information to our customers during the charging process, we would like to know if there is any possibility to activate the transmission of this value.
Can it be sent together with the other values like “Current.Offered” and “Power.Offered” during the charging process?
Thank you for your help.
Best regards,
Sabine Krause
Head of Project Management
&
Support | Filling Station Solutions
Hectronic GmbH  |  Allmendstrasse 15  |  79848 Bonndorf

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0482966-DC/Si-D/DE- [Null] Meter value WH Missing CRM:03288000463
additional_info.body:
Hallo Sabine,
ich übernehme hier dieses Ticket und der Konfigurationsauszug, den du uns gesendet hast, zeigt bereits, wo das Problem liegt. Ich sende dir hier unser Software-Manual. Dort findest du unter MeterValuesSampledData, welche Werte möglich sind. per BackendConfig
Die aktuellen Einstellungen bei diesem Ladegerät sind:
"MeterValuesSampleedData"
:
{
"readonly"
:
false
,
"value"
:
"SoC,Power.Offered,Current.Offered"
}
Wenn ich mich nicht täusche, sind das die Standardwerte, die ab Werk eingestellt werden also default werte. Das Backend muss nun gemäß OCPP 1.6 die Werte ergänzen, die ihr anzeigen möchtet. Bitte lies dazu im OCPP-Protokoll nach; die relevanten Informationen sollten unter 'Measurands' zu finden sein.
Thank you.
With best regards,
Semih Sentürk
eMobility Tech Support Team
